demos.name: Worker Agent Demo
demos.description: A worker agent acting for a person: attended, delegated (agent to agent) and unattended runs, every tool call through a policy enforcement point that allows, denies or holds for approval. Mock only.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 6700). Needs the Privilege demo on 4510 and its stub issuer on 9031 (see that repo). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=6700 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is an absolute path on this machine; change it if the repo lives elsewhere. Catalog id D22 is provisional (D23 is the digital worker); confirm with the shelf owner.
